definitions.explanation: Something that is contrary to what one expected or anticipated. Can be used as a na-adjective or as a noun meaning 'unexpectedness.'

examples.japanese: {意外|いがい}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{意外|いがい}だった。
examples.english: It was surprising that he was good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {意外|いがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だった。
examples.english: Surprisingly, the exam questions were easy.
examples.notes: {意外|いがい}にも is an adverbial usage meaning 'surprisingly' or 'contrary to expectations.'

notes:
{意外|いがい} means something is contrary to expectations — either positively or negatively surprising.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意外|いがい}な + noun: unexpected (adjective)
- {意外|いがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ / {意外|いがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: surprisingly (adverb)
- {意外|いがい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: unexpectedly, more than expected (colloquial adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意外|いがい}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: unexpected result
- {意外|いがい}な⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧: unexpected development
- {意外|いがい}な⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: surprising fact

CONTRAST WITH {以外|いがい}:
- {意外|いがい}: unexpected, surprising (adjective/noun)
- ⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧: other than, besides (noun/particle)
These are homophones but have completely different meanings and kanji.
